nfl.oneThing: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has been placed on injured reserve with a right thumb injury that required surgery, and Tyler Huntley is on IR with a toe injury. Baltimore (4-4) sits just outside the AFC playoff seeds, one game back.

headlines.title: Jonathan Taylor's trade talk drags on as Colts and Cowboys meet
headlines.summary: Colts running back Jonathan Taylor says the trade chatter has become 'regular scheduled programming'. He has been linked to several teams, and some have questioned whether the Colts should even play this Sunday. Taylor signed a two-year extension worth $44 million in August and has never played for another team. The Colts (2-6) and Cowboys (3-5) meet Sunday, two days before the trade deadline. The matchup was meant to showcase the Downs brothers, but one is requesting a trade and the other is in concussion protocol with a bad ankle.
headlines.whyItMatters: Both teams are struggling, so a deal before the deadline could reshape either roster. Taylor's future is the storyline to watch around this game.

headlines.title: Vikings start Carson Wentz on Monday night with Kyler Murray out
headlines.summary: Minnesota will start Carson Wentz against the Buffalo Bills on Monday night. Kyler Murray has been ruled out with a hamstring injury. The Vikings are 6-1 and the Bills are 6-1, and Minnesota sits second in the NFC.
headlines.whyItMatters: With both teams at 6-1, a quarterback change for a Monday night game is a big test for the Vikings' push at the top of the NFC.

headlines.title: Malik Nabers set to play, Cam Skattebo likely out for the Giants
headlines.summary: Malik Nabers was named NFC Offensive Player of the Month for October, but he sat out Thursday's practice with a knee issue. He told reporters he will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Eagles. Cam Skattebo has missed three straight practices with a hamstring injury and is likely to miss the game. The Giants have Devin Singletary and Gregory Desrosiers on the 53-man roster. Offensive coordinator Matt Nagy said keeping the run game going is the priority.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Giants (4-2-1) are third in the NFC. Nabers missed most of last season after a torn ACL, so his health matters for the offence. Their running game without Skattebo is the question against Philadelphia.

headlines.title: Packers' offence is leaning hard on Jordan Love
headlines.summary: Yahoo Sports reports that the Packers' rushing attack has been unproductive and that the team leads the league in dropped passes. That has put a lot on Jordan Love, who leads the league with 2,246 passing yards. Green Bay is 5-3 and seventh in the NFC. Micah Parsons is out with a torn ACL.
headlines.whyItMatters: If the run game does not improve, the Packers will have a hard time keeping pace in the NFC playoff race.

contextCard.title: How NFL tiebreakers work
contextCard.body: When teams finish with the same record, the NFL breaks the tie in a set order. Head-to-head results usually come first, followed by record within the division, record against common opponents and conference record. Those tiebreakers can decide division titles and wild-card spots, so they matter more as the season goes on.

headlines.title: 76ers off to 8-1 and the best record in the league
headlines.summary: The 76ers beat the Pistons 112–106 on Wednesday to improve to 8-1, the best record in the NBA. Joel Embiid had 26 points and 15 rebounds, and Jaylen Brown scored 30. Philadelphia has won five straight games. LeBron James cautioned that it is too early to talk about the Finals, even with the strong start.
headlines.whyItMatters: Philadelphia sits first in the East, a game and a half clear of Detroit on the strength of that start. The 76ers are the team to beat in the East so far.

headlines.title: Luka Doncic keeps the Lakers rolling
headlines.summary: Luka Doncic scored 40 points in the Lakers' 116–103 win over the Kings, his sixth straight game with 35 or more points. He joins Kobe Bryant and Elgin Baylor as the only Lakers to do that.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Lakers are second in the West, and Doncic's scoring is the main reason they have started so well. The Kings are 1-7 and sit near the bottom of the West.

headlines.title: Kon Knueppel's season debut cut short by injury
headlines.summary: Hornets rookie Kon Knueppel was injured after six minutes of his season debut. The Hornets (3-6) have dropped five straight games. Last season Charlotte went 44-38, a year after going 19-63, and Knueppel's availability is a big question for the team.
headlines.whyItMatters: If Knueppel misses more time, it is a hard blow for a team that was one of last season's biggest surprises. Charlotte sits 10th in the East.

recaps.text: Victor Wembanyama was the story, but the Mavericks made it close. Dallas rallied from 19 points down in the second half and had a late lead before Kyrie Irving's last-second shot failed to drop. Wembanyama played through a virus, per the San Antonio Express-News, and the Spurs held on for their sixth straight win. Dallas has lost two in a row and drops to 4-4.

Anthony Edwards is out after knee surgery, so the Timberwolves won without their star. Houston drops to 7-2.

Tyrese Haliburton is out with a hamstring strain, so the Pacers won without their star guard. Cedric Coward and Ty Jerome had strong nights for Memphis, but the Grizzlies have lost two straight.
